issues: Location was imprecise but not false. The record puts the pin on the San Francisco city centroid and says the venue is not named on the Commons page. That is true of Commons, but the event can be identified. The Commons description names the 'EFF Pioneer Award event in 2018', and the name badge in the photo reads '2018 Pioneer Awards'. EFF's own event page (eff.org/awards/pioneer/2018) says 'On September 27, we will celebrate the work of our 2018 Pioneer Awards Ceremony honorees' (FOUND) and '6:00 pm - 10:00 pm at Delancey Street Town Hall 600 Embarcadero St. San Francisco, California, 94107' (FOUND). The pin now uses the OSM geocode of 600 The Embarcadero, and the caption gives the date and venue.

Date note: the Commons DateTimeOriginal '2018-09-28 07:25:55' is the camera clock, which was probably not set to Pacific time. The ceremony was the evening of 27 September 2018 (Pacific). The record's year 2018 is right.

Checked OK otherwise: the Commons API extmetadata was re-queried on 2026-09-23. It gives LicenseShortName 'CC BY-SA 4.0', LicenseUrl https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0, Artist 'Kushal Das', Credit 'Own work', ImageDescription 'Photo of John Gilmore taken at the EFF Pioneer Award event in 2018.', and the file-page template {{self|cc-by-sa-4.0}}. The file also carries a VRTS permission ticket, {{PermissionTicket|id=2024041210008168}}. The licence is acceptable (CC BY-SA). The local file assets/media/john-gilmore-2018.jpg exists and opens as a 960x1440 RGB JPEG. The alt text matches the image: a bald man with a long grey beard in a blue-purple EFF hoodie printed 'EFF.ORG/BARLOW', with a badge reading 'EFF presents 2018 Pioneer Awards / STAFF / John Gilmore', in a crowded room.

But the conference is identified, and its venue is on record: libreplanet.org/2019 says 'March 23rd - 24th Stata Center Massachusetts Institute of Technology Cambridge, MA' (FOUND). The pin moves from the Cambridge/Harvard Square centroid (42.3736, -71.1097) to the OSM geocode of the Stata Center, 32 Vassar St.

Date caution, no field change needed: the Commons 'date' and DateTimeOriginal '2019-04-23' is when the photo was added to media.libreplanet.org, not when it was taken. The conference ran 23-24 March 2019, and the MediaGoblin page shows it 'Added 7 years, 5 months ago' as of Sept 2026, which is consistent with April 2019. Anything that renders a day should use March 2019, not 23 April. The year 2019 is right.
